topic: Every technical claim in the consolidated documentation must be traceable to an
canonical_claim: Every technical claim in the consolidated documentation must be traceable to an old document or the code, and each target document must label relevant sections `DONE`, `TODO`, `REJECTED`, or `DESIRABLE`.

The consolidation keeps all `docs/superpowers/models/*.tla` and `*.cfg` sources untouched and also keeps the active D1 spec, plan, and model; their prose results and readmes may be consolidated separately.

topic: The consolidation is explicitly synthesis rather than concatenation
canonical_claim: The consolidation is explicitly synthesis rather than concatenation: new documents should remain manageable, and claims must not be invented.

topic: New pages under `docs/en/` require frontmatter fields `description`, `sidebar_la
canonical_claim: New pages under `docs/en/` require frontmatter fields `description`, `sidebar_label`, `sidebar_position`, `slug`, `title`, and `doc_type`, and every heading requires an explicit kebab-case anchor.

topic: CAS is described as experimental because the code is actively cleaned up and bac
canonical_claim: CAS is described as experimental because the code is actively cleaned up and backward-incompatible format changes remain possible, while the implementation is intended to work correctly today.

topic: The obscure-name cleanup changes CamelCase `Gc` to `GC`, `Ckpt` to `Checkpoint`,
canonical_claim: The obscure-name cleanup changes CamelCase `Gc` to `GC`, `Ckpt` to `Checkpoint`, `Txns` to `Transactions`, and `Dedup` to `Deduplication` in user-facing CAS names.

topic: The documentation-consolidation plan requires a small structured `docs/superpowe
canonical_claim: The documentation-consolidation plan requires a small structured `docs/superpowers/cas/` set that captures load-bearing invariants, decisions, failed paths, and technical details without narrative noise.

topic: The planned canonical CAS documentation set includes `README
canonical_claim: The planned canonical CAS documentation set includes `README.md`, `01-architecture.md` through `08-testing-and-soak.md`, and `ROADMAP.md`, with topic-structured rather than dated or milestone-structured documents.

topic: Published CAS pages are intended to be skimmable in about two minutes, use short
canonical_claim: Published CAS pages are intended to be skimmable in about two minutes, use short prose with tables and Mermaid diagrams, and stay below a 300-line soft limit and a 500-line hard limit.

topic: The canonical CAS spelling is `CAS` in CamelCase identifiers, SQL keywords, gran
canonical_claim: The canonical CAS spelling is `CAS` in CamelCase identifiers, SQL keywords, grants, and prose, and `cas` in snake_case table names, settings, config keys, test names, and tags.
